lines.text: STAND-IN Elder: first greeting. This line shows only on the first visit.

lines.speaker: standin_elder
lines.text: STAND-IN clue: the Elder is known to help visitors who are empathetic.

choices.text: STAND-IN: answer warmly (personality shift toward empathy; Companion A and Companion B react differently)
STAND-IN: answer coolly (personality shift toward cunning; the same two react the other way round)
STAND-IN: answer warmly, with a written reaction for Companion B and silence from Companion A

reactions.text: STAND-IN reaction: {name} gives a written line that replaces the archetype reaction.

choices.text: STAND-IN: ask the Elder for help (always offered; the outcome depends on a hidden empathy condition)

lines.speaker: standin_elder
lines.text: STAND-IN Elder: reply to a warm answer.

lines.speaker: standin_elder
lines.text: STAND-IN Elder: reply to a cool answer.

lines.speaker: standin_elder
lines.text: STAND-IN Elder: help given, because your empathy was high enough.

lines.speaker: standin_elder
lines.text: STAND-IN Elder: help refused, because your empathy was not high enough yet.

lines.speaker: standin_elder
lines.text: STAND-IN Elder: second greeting, shown because you have talked here before.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: STAND-IN: this extra line appears only because you answered warmly the first time.

choices.text: STAND-IN: ask for a favor (trait-gated; opens the gate spot)
choices.lockedText: STAND-IN: locked until you are more empathetic.

choices.text: STAND-IN: make small talk (ungated fallback for the favor)

lines.speaker: standin_elder
lines.text: STAND-IN Elder: favor granted. A new gate spot now exists in town.

lines.text: STAND-IN Smith: greeting.

lines.speaker: standin_smith
lines.text: STAND-IN Smith: I stand here now because of your earlier request.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: STAND-IN: the Smith remembers that you spoke warmly to the Elder.

choices.text: STAND-IN: nod politely (slight shift toward empathy)
STAND-IN: speak from the heart (strong shift toward empathy)
STAND-IN: ask the Smith to stand elsewhere (a person moves because of this choice)
STAND-IN: ask about travelers (a new person appears because of this choice)
STAND-IN: ask about the bell (chains into a narrated scene)

lines.speaker: standin_smith
lines.text: STAND-IN Smith: moving to a new spot.

lines.speaker: standin_smith
lines.text: STAND-IN Smith: a traveler has appeared in town.

lines.speaker: standin_guard
lines.text: STAND-IN Guard: milder greeting, shown once the Guard distrusts you less.

lines.speaker: standin_guard
